source_grounding.source_excerpt: Two different REST structs serve the two endpoints: alter_properties binds CollectionReqWithProperties (request_v2.go:80-84: DbName/CollectionName/Properties map) whose Properties flow into alterCollectionTask where detectQueryModeChange -> common.ValidateQueryMode (task.go:1351-1353) rejects bad values (and even catches misspellings via EqualFold at common.go:521-522); create binds CollectionReq (request_v2.go:643-656) with NO Properties field and a params forwarding whitelist that excludes query_mode - hence create accepts anything silently while alter validates strictly and, for unknown non-reserved keys, persists them raw (no whitelist on alter properties map). The asymmetry is fully explained by the two-struct architecture.
source_grounding.call_chain_traced: create: JSON properties -> no struct field -> drop -> code 0. alter: JSON properties -> CollectionReqWithProperties -> alterCollectionTask -> ValidateQueryMode (known keys) OR raw persist (unknown keys)
